title.narrative: Strengthening certification services to enhance export competitiveness of small and medium agribusinesses

description.narrative: 1. In 2018, UNIDO has commenced negotiations with the World Bank Group (WBG) to build a solid partnership and integrate its technical knowledge and expertise in WBG#s investment portfolio. 2. As a result of the mission by UNIDO delegation to Washington in September 2018, the two organizations have agreed on priority countries and sectors for agribusiness cooperation, including food safety capacity building as one of the main thematic areas. 3. UNIDO is currently implementing the project Support to Employment Creation in Mongolia (SECiM), targeting leather, dairy and meat value chains. 4. As part of a bilateral discussion during the Global Forum for Food and Agriculture (GFFA) in January 2020 in Berlin, the Minister of Agriculture of Mongolia and its management showed interest to involve UNIDO as an implementing agency in a World Bank funded project entitled the Mongolia Export Development Project.
